title: Analysis code for "What Do We See When We Look at Food? Category and Semantic Structure in Food Representations"
description: Code that rebuilds every analysis, figure and table in the paper from the anonymised trial-level data (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23498576) and the PAFID item information (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23226251). Run bash run_all.sh quick for the main analyses or bash run_all.sh full to add the noise ceilings and the Shapley variance attribution. Participant identifiers and row order in the public data are shuffled, so order-dependent steps (SPoSE training, split-half noise ceilings) reproduce approximately; the paper's SPoSE seed-20 solution is included. The 82 participants excluded before analysis are not in the public data.
